claims.statement: Tom Allen and Ben Hogan are entered for a ring contest to be shown on October 28, 1873.
claims.excerpt: BEN. HOGAN and-Tom Allen were at the Fair yesterday. They are entered for the rimg that will be shown on the 28th.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was already in trim for the Hogan fight, while Ben Hogan was still getting in trim.
claims.excerpt: Ben. is getling in trim,and Tom isallready.

fights.excerpt: They are entered for the rimg that will be shown on the 28th.
fights.notes: Date is the 28th of the month printed; the month is inferred from the paper's date.

notes: 'Yesterday' is taken as 1873-10-07. Tom Isallready is a garbled line; the statement reads it as 'Tom is already'.
